title: Content Pillars — The System That Makes You Consistent

slides.heading: CONTENT PILLARS
slides.subheading: The System That Makes You Consistent

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Choose 3–5 pillars that represent your identity, expertise, and audience needs.
Every piece of content should map to one pillar.
Pillars prevent burnout, eliminate decision fatigue, and keep your message coherent across platforms.

slides.heading: PILLAR GRID
slides.caption: Every post must serve a pillar.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Your strongest pillar should produce 50% of your content.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Posting randomly without a strategic framework.
